# 相似矩阵和若尔当标准型

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display

A = Matrix([
    [4, 0],
    [0, 4],
])
display(A.jordan_form())

A = Matrix([
    [4, 1],
    [0, 4],
])
display(A.jordan_form())
display(A.rank())
display(A.eigenvals())

A = Matrix([
    [5, 1],
    [-1, 3],
])
display(A.jordan_form())

A = Matrix([
    [4, 0],
    [17, 4],
])
display(A.jordan_form())
```

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display

A = Matrix([
    [4, 4],
    [-3, 3],
])
display("A", "A.T", A, A.T)
display("ATA", ATA := A.T * A)
display("ATA.eigenvects()", ATA.eigenvects())
display("AAT", AAT := A * A.T)
display("AAT.eigenvects()", AAT.eigenvects())
display("A.singular_value_decomposition()", *A.singular_value_decomposition())
```

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display

A = Matrix([
    [4, 3],
    [8, 6],
])
display(*A.singular_value_decomposition())
```
